agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.7 to v0.4.8 without resetting. Stop writers and back up D1, R2, Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.68. Apply exactly the seven listed missing migrations, 150 through 156, by name in filename order before the updated Worker starts, including below already applied rows. Preserve all prior ledger identities and bytes; unknown, changed or uncertain history is refused and final readback is checked. Never delete, reorder or edit ledger rows. Retain owners, imported support history, permissions, files and erasure fences. The seven mailbox settings remain optional and held secrets are inherited. Run rer deploy --dry-run against the retained installation before deployment; missing required secrets now refuse. R5 adds business hours, SLAs, event/time rules, routing, follow-ups and schedules. Existing SLA and default-close previews remain inert; preview and publish explicitly. One statement budget covers the entire scheduled invocation. Bulk and macro continuations are durable; interrupted notice attempts remain visibly uncertain without replay. Retain human Send.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.8 ships R5: business hours and holiday calendars, SLAs, event and time rules, routing, follow-ups, snoozes and schedules. One database statement budget covers the whole scheduled handler. Bulk actions and macros have durable continuations, bounded notice delivery and explicit outcomes after interruption. Upgrade from v0.4.7 adds exactly seven migrations, 150-156, through pinned rer 0.2.68. Back up and retain settings without resetting or editing migration history. Mailbox provider settings remain optional. Production deployment is separate.
